## Description

The description the MCP server sends to the model, word for word. Its rules apply to every call.

> Get the next N available posting slots based on your schedule template and already-scheduled notes. Pass tagNames to preview as if scheduling a note with those tags (first open or matching reserved lane; tagged previews skip untagged-only times). Omit tagNames to list the next free times in chronological order, including reserved and untagged-only times that are currently empty — do not assume an untagged note can use reserved times, or that a tagged note can use untagged-only times. Each result includes source (lane | open | any), the slot's tags, and untaggedNotesOnly. Call this before schedule_notes to preview when notes would be scheduled. Queue routing: each weekly time can reserve tags, accept only untagged notes, or stay open for any note, and may also set default Buffer channels. A time with tags is a reserved lane — it stays empty until a note shares ANY of those tags (OR). A time marked untaggedNotesOnly (and with no tags) accepts only notes with no tags; tagged notes never take those times, including Add to Queue leftovers. Untagged notes never take reserved lanes. When filling the next template times (schedule_notes), a tagged note takes the first open (any-note) time or matching reserved lane, whichever comes first. An untagged note takes the first open or untagged-only time. If a time has Buffer channels, those replace the note's channels when the note lands there (apply-on-schedule only). Substack still always posts. Call get_schedule to see each slot's tags, untaggedNotesOnly, and bufferChannels.

## Arguments

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | `number` | Yes | Number of available slots to return (1–100) Min 1. Max 100. |
| `tagNames` | `string[]` | No | Optional tag names to preview as if scheduling a note with those tags. Uses the first open (any-note) time or matching reserved lane, whichever comes first. Tagged previews skip untagged-only times. Several slot tags are OR — one shared tag is enough. Omit to list the next free times in chronological order, including reserved and untagged-only times that are currently empty — do not assume an untagged note can use reserved times, or that a tagged note can use untagged-only times. Call list_tags first if you need valid names. |
